corpus_description: synthetic OpenTelemetry logs generated by the OpenTelemetry demo application
ngram_adaptation: same tokenization followed by wildcard 3grams; norm unsupported; exact term control uses ts_like('error') without wildcard; only count/ID predicates evaluated, without ranking
schema_adaptation: reduced search-backed table: sample row ordinal id BIGINT, Body VARCHAR; native Body analyzer retained; no ranking, full-row projection, or joins
scan_semantics: same ASCII alphanumeric tokenization/lowercasing, evaluated as a scalar scan
space_accounting: source sample Parquet shared; search-backed tables ingest Body and id; full metric identity rows retained without deduplication; database_directory_bytes measured separately

queries.name: q27_infix_count
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM otel_logs WHERE array_length(list_filter(split_by_non_alpha(Body, case := 'lower', break := 'ascii'), token -> token LIKE '%nnec%'), 1) > 0

queries.name: q27_infix_locate
queries.source_query: Q27 predicate, complete sorted sample IDs
queries.sql: SELECT id FROM otel_logs WHERE array_length(list_filter(split_by_non_alpha(Body, case := 'lower', break := 'ascii'), token -> token LIKE '%nnec%'), 1) > 0 ORDER BY id

queries.name: q25_prefix_count

queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM otel_logs WHERE array_length(list_filter(split_by_non_alpha(Body, case := 'lower', break := 'ascii'), token -> token LIKE '%tion'), 1) > 0

queries.name: q01_term_count
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM otel_logs WHERE array_length(list_filter(split_by_non_alpha(Body, case := 'lower', break := 'ascii'), token -> token = 'error'), 1) > 0

queries.name: control_absent_count
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM otel_logs WHERE array_length(list_filter(split_by_non_alpha(Body, case := 'lower', break := 'ascii'), token -> token LIKE '%zzzzfmindexnotpresentzzzz%'), 1) > 0
